instruction:
Nursery Cluster Issue Set with Occupancy Schedule

Start from a blank Archicad project with no init files or local reference images. Build or edit the model using Archicad BIM elements, not visual-only placeholder geometry. Save the completed deliverables in the output folder as result.ifc, result.pdf, and result.txt.

Create a single-storey BIM model for the named project. Keep the shaped model within 0.5 m of horizontal extents about X 0 to 15 and Y 0 to 17, with vertical extents about Z -0.3 to 4.35. Export result.ifc as an IFC4 model with unique GlobalId values for IFC root objects. It must contain exactly 1 building storey and exactly 8 IfcSpace zones named CLASSROOM-1, CLASSROOM-2, CLASSROOM-3, COMMON, SLEEP, STAFF, WC-CHILD, and WC-STAFF. Assign every listed space to the single building storey.

Model the required construction as real BIM element classes, including at least 1 IfcSlab element, and at least 1 IfcRoof element. If an equivalent exporter writes IfcWallStandardCase for walls, that is acceptable. Do not count IfcBuildingElementProxy or other generic proxy objects as satisfying required walls, slabs, roofs, stairs, doors, windows, or spaces.

Export result.txt from the Archicad schedule/list workflow as a tab-delimited schedule text file. The header row must be ZoneName, Area, Storey in that order. Include these rows in order: (ZoneName=CLASSROOM-1, Area=20, Storey=GROUND); (ZoneName=CLASSROOM-2, Area=20, Storey=GROUND); (ZoneName=CLASSROOM-3, Area=20, Storey=GROUND); (ZoneName=COMMON, Area=36, Storey=GROUND); (ZoneName=SLEEP, Area=16, Storey=GROUND); (ZoneName=STAFF, Area=9, Storey=GROUND); (ZoneName=WC-CHILD, Area=9, Storey=GROUND); (ZoneName=WC-STAFF, Area=7.5, Storey=GROUND).

Publish result.pdf as a 2-page drawing set. The visible sheet text must include A131, PLAN, SECTION, NURSERY CLUSTER WITH OCCUPANCY SCHEDULE, CLASSROOM-1, COMMON, SLEEP, and WC-STAFF so the title, drawing type, and key rooms or zones are identifiable.

Other materials, colors, object names, property sets, layer names, relationship nesting, and IFC representation details may vary as long as the required BIM elements, spatial relationships, geometry ranges, schedules, and sheet text are present.
